proof_attribution: The book is single-authored by Yufei Zhao; the manuscript's first page and the observed author page carry that authorship, and no separate per-theorem byline exists. The technique is attributed in the printed Remark 1.7.2 to Alon, Krivelevich and Sudakov (2003a) and historically to Furedi (1991), and the printed proof here is the book's own exposition of the method. That historical route credit is recorded as attribution and is not treated as an additional author of this unit, and no referenced paper was acquired.

statement_spans.source_role: Exact printed Theorem 1.7.5: n,r,m,t positive integers and alpha>0; every graph on n vertices with at least alpha n^2/2 edges has a vertex subset U with |U| >= n alpha^t - binom(n,r)(m/n)^t such that every r-element subset S of U has more than m common neighbors in G. Literal weak/strict quantifiers kept; physical50/printed34

proof_spans.source_role: Complete printed proof, unabridged and in printed order, preceded by the printed Remark 1.7.6 on parameters: bad = at most m common neighbors; hosts u_1..u_t uniform and independent with replacement; A their common neighbourhood and explicitly random; E|A| through linearity and convexity with the printed subscript v in V; fixed-R containment probability; bad-R bound; sum over binom(n,r) subsets; alteration by deleting one element per bad r-subset; final E|U| bound. The printed schematic is redrawn in TikZ to the printed structure (four top markers labelled only u_1, central ellipsis and u_t; seven bottom vertices in the shaded A strip; complete join) and is disclosed as a redrawing. physical51/printed35
